motivation: Ask this site to build what chuggy main is now. The change is the one request document scripts/request-build writes under requests/ and nothing else: which images, from which source, under which profile, is this site's declaration in scripts/build_sources.py and not a brief's.
acceptanceCriteria: The diff is one file under requests/chuggy/<commit>/, written by scripts/request-build for the commit chuggy main was at when the work ran, and the release manifests still identify one source.
constraints: The work is the one command below, which resolves chuggy main itself and commits nothing it did not write. A refusal (exit 3) is this ticket's failure and its attempts are its budget: the request is already filed, or this site declares nothing for the source. Read AGENTS.md and .chug/tasks/review-change.md before judging the change.

A build request for this site's own images and the worker is not asked for this way: an operator renders it with scripts/render-build-request from the previous request's arguments for the same image, never hand-written, and it lands by a change of its own.

main is live: Flux applies cluster/ and builds/, and the publisher answers a landed request with builds under builds/, so the merge this ticket lands by is what starts the build. requests/ and results/ Flux does not apply.
Do not rebuild or switch a host, reconcile Flux, apply manifests, restart infrastructure, reset data, or deploy.

instructions: Read .chug/tasks/review-change.md and review the change exactly as that brief requires.
